judgement.reason: The app's core data appears to live on local disk, in a Prisma SQLite database and a built-in local vector store, which Deployz's stateless containers cannot keep; the shown lines do not prove whether a PostgreSQL option exists.

evidence.quote: Out of the box you get built-in agents, multi-user support, vector databases, and document pipelines — no extra configuration required.
runs locally by default with zero setup friction.
